$comment: The blog's account resources (docs/plans/accounts.md). Every object is scoped to the estate's platform (platform:psi): psi's visitors belong to no organisation. The OWNER of a record is a per-record grant the application supplies at Check time as a contextual tuple, read from its own row (the system of record); nothing about a visitor is persisted in OpenFGA. Staff reach records only through the catalog roles below, granted in Polaris. No role reads guide memory or clinical data; none exists here.
